svg.aria-label: What is in the box for FIX-2071. Inside: the rename table, one committed codemod per child, every renamed identifier added to one identifier sweep that CI runs, and docs and READMEs in the new words. Composed in by consumers: their own flows action names, and a rewrite at upgrade from the changesets. Below the fence, not built here: the four message names FIX-2070 removes, words that collide but are not retired, whether a raw ctx.suspend stays public (FIX-2230), and history: specs, changesets, changelogs and verdict logs.
